C · Light, with four tiles

A white menu: your name on a soft card, then four big tiles for what people open most (Saakhis first), then the rest as a short list. Modern and roomy; drops the navy look.

What changes whichever you pick

  • The menu slides in from the left and covers most of the screen, with Today dimmed behind it. Tap outside it, swipe it left, or press Back to close it. The ☰ button on every tab opens it, as now.
  • Everything in today's menu stays: profile, badges, library, notifications, settings, privacy, about, help. Only the shape changes, and Saakhis is added.
  • Both entries lead to the same place: a Saakhis library with the four cards, then the reader you approved.
  • Nothing is counted (SK7): no ticks or streaks for saakhis on Today.
  • Once you choose, I draw the chosen screens properly in the project's design set (light and dark), update the specs, and build them.
